jobs.description: ABOUT THE ROLE VTEX is looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the future of Content Management across our Commerce Platform. This role is for product builders. We’re looking for someone who doesn’t just write specs and manage roadmaps, but someone who actively uses modern AI tools, rapid prototyping techniques, and emerging technologies to accelerate discovery, validation, and execution. As the Product Manager for CMS, you will shape how brands, marketers, developers, and AI systems create, manage, and deliver digital experiences on VTEX. You will be responsible for defining the next generation of content management capabilities, helping customers move faster from idea to production while maintaining the flexibility and performance required by enterprise commerce. You will work at the intersection of commerce, content, AI, developer experience, and user experience. Success in this role requires strong product judgment, technical curiosity, and a passion for building. We expect you to be comfortable turning ideas into working prototypes, leveraging tools like Claude Code, Spec Kit, AI coding assistants, agents, MCP-based workflows, and other emerging technologies to validate solutions. This is a role for someone who believes the future of product management is increasingly hands-on and AI-native. ABOUT THE TEAM The CMS team owns the systems that power content creation, collaboration, and delivery across storefronts. Our mission is to enable merchants to create rich, performant, and personalized digital experiences with speed and confidence. We build the experience that powers everything from landing pages and merchandising experiences to personalized content journeys and AI-assisted content operations. As commerce becomes increasingly AI-driven, the CMS team is at the forefront of defining how content, data, agents, and commerce workflows come together. jobs.title: Content & Social Contractor, FloElite
jobs.description: FloSports is a world-class sports media company strategically positioned to be the essential destination for passionate sports fans, delighting them with live event coverage, breaking news, highlights, stats, rankings, and team and player profiles. We are growing Our Sports every day by continuing to invest in our ever-expanding ecosystem, which consists of over a dozen sport verticals and hundreds of streaming partners. FloSports is creating the home for college conferences/leagues and sports like grappling, hockey, track & field, racing, cheer, wrestling, and more, and we are looking for innovative and passionate people like you to help us! THE ROLE: FloSports is looking for a Content & Social Contractor to support FloElite, our destination for CrossFit and functional fitness competition. This is a highly hands-on role for someone who deeply understands the CrossFit community and knows how to turn live competitions, athletes and storylines into compelling social content that grows our audience and drives fans to watch on FloElite. You’ll be the primary person responsible for FloElite’s social presence, including ideating, creating and publishing content around live events and maintaining an active, relevant presence between competitions. Because FloElite’s live event calendar is more concentrated than some of our other sports, this role requires someone who can find creative ways to keep the audience engaged even when there is not an event happening every weekend. jobs.description: Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust. In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.
